prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one wide 16:9 style exploration frame for a professional AI brand animation. The user explicitly wants a CLEANER, SIMPLER, UNCLUTTERED 3D choice. PRIORITY: visual simplicity, smooth surfaces, generous empty space, restrained palette, readable character expressions. No busy technical set.
Input images: official identity references ONLY: image 1 Chacha; image 2 Chamei. Convert their shapes into fully modeled 3D with clear depth and soft physically coherent shadows. Do NOT import the black drawing outline, paper fibers, watercolor texture or reference-sheet labels.
Subjects: exactly two familiar characters, waist-up, positioned with room to breathe. Chacha left: white broad softly rounded face, tiny rounded ears, small black round eyes, tiny black nose and smile, mint-green simple T-shirt, squat body, large white tail with exactly two black elongated marks. No animal-realistic muzzle, whiskers or giant eyes. Chamei right: orange bear-ear hood including the small bear face on the hood, simple brown fringe and side locks, warm pale stylized face, small dark oval eyes, restrained rosy cheek circles, small rounded hands. No realistic human face. Keep the upper-body identity, avoid inventing lower-body details.
Action: two characters stand behind one thin, simple off-white worktable. Chacha gently slides ONE small mint rectangular card toward Chamei; she receives it with one round hand and a modest curious smile. Both look at the exchange. The card has only ONE plain white image icon. At most this one prop; no additional laptop, cubes, cables, watermelon, plants, cups, posters or floating widgets. This is an abstract business interaction, not actual UI.
Composition: calm professional eye-level medium-wide two-shot, 50mm perspective, both faces and hands clearly visible, entire head silhouettes comfortably inside frame, top quarter mostly clean empty space, clear separation between figures. Faces have small intelligent expressions, no open-mouthed infant joy, no oversized sparkling eyes. Foreground table limited to lower quarter, no giant product clutter.
Materials on characters: smooth non-fuzzy matte surfaces with very subtle broad reflectance, no fur, plush, felt, knit, weave, visible brush strokes, halftone dots, scratches, pores or grain. Clothing has only 2-3 broad simple modeled folds, hair is clean sculpted masses, no strand texture. No black outlines, no cel shadow bands, no glitter, no high-frequency noise, no glossy plastic glare. Their simplified geometry and soft shadow gradients make them clearly 3D.
Palette: neutral warm white and pale gray dominate; mint-green shirt/card and orange hood are controlled accents, brown hair and tiny black facial features. No overall orange cast, no mustard sunlight, no neon green wash. No text, logos, typography, watermark, labels, grids or extra characters.
Style direction M: clean minimal matte 3D animated brand film. Seamless pale warm-gray cyclorama background with absolutely no architecture or scenery, just a very subtle tonal gradient. Off-white smooth tabletop with thin rounded edge. Broad soft studio key from upper left and balanced neutral fill; very soft but present contact shadows. Surfaces feel like refined animation materials, not fuzzy soft toys. Moderate gentle contrast with excellent separation of white character from background. Extremely economical composition, generous negative space, no adornments. Focus on the two original characters and the single exchanged card.
